# Sell your ESPP shares now, or hold for the tax break?

> Free ESPP tax calculator. Enter your offering and purchase prices, discount and lookback to see the after-tax profit of selling at purchase, after a year, or at a qualifying date, and the price where waiting stops paying. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
